_comment: Pixel geometry of each in-game collection panel, measured at reference_width x reference_height and scaled proportionally to any screenshot (see vision/grid_calibration.py). One entry per panel. 'legacy_blueprint' is the original single Blueprints panel from before the Frozen Trail update, and is what the regression fixtures in tests/fixtures were calibrated against. A new game UI means editing or adding an entry here, not changing code. 'enabled': false keeps a panel's scanner off until it has been verified against real screenshots.
